data: What is the lowest accuracy of the model in figure 1?

The lowest accuracy of the model in Figure 1 can be determined by examining the range of the gray lines representing individual model accuracies. These lines represent the variation in model performance across different initializations. The lowest point among these lines corresponds to the minimum accuracy achieved by any of the 100 models. By visually inspecting the graph, the lowest accuracy appears to be around 76%. This can also be confirmed by looking at the y-axis values and the position of the gray lines.
